name: captain-finance-wlt
objective: Verify and close Captain wallet/COD/commission/payout readback and permitted self-service actions from canonical WLT truth, without duplicating existing commission functionality.
truthOwner: WLT exclusively owns wallet/ledger, COD financial liability, commission policy/calculation/lifecycle, payout financial state and adjustments; DSH may proxy bounded authenticated operations/references only.

tasks.objective: Prove existing Captain own-finance readback and actor isolation
tasks.currentProblem: Current BB already exposes Captain wallet/ledger/commission/payout readback, but the old package incorrectly treats commission readback as missing and lacks same-candidate proof of route/contract isolation and error behavior.
tasks.requiredChange: Verify the current WltCaptainFinanceScreen → generic representative components/API → authenticated DSH representative-finance routes → WLT chain. Repair only reproduced contract, actor-scope, state mapping, error/partial handling or canonical-readback defects; do not add a parallel commission implementation.
tasks.targetState: Captain sees only own canonical wallet/ledger/commission/payout state including required commission lifecycle/reasons; another Captain cannot influence or read it, and failures never fabricate financial success/zero.
tasks.action: Execute current app-captain and DSH/WLT checks, inspect generated/schema parity and negative actor cases, trace authenticated actor derivation into WLT query, fix the truth owner/adapter only if evidence fails, then rerun all affected generic consumers when shared code changes.
mustNotChange: Do not implement a second Captain commission source/read model.
Do not accept authoritative commission/earnings amounts from frontend or DSH callers.
Do not expose another Captain's financial records.
Do not turn generic shared-component proximity into app-field/partner product scope.
acceptanceCriteria: Captain own-finance routes derive actor identity server-side and reject cross-Captain access.
Commission states/reasons/policy/source displayed by Captain come from WLT-backed canonical readback with no local aggregate calculation.
Wallet/ledger/commission/payout error/empty/partial states do not fabricate zero or completed financial state.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused finance adapter/backend fix while preserving WLT ownership and current working self-service routes; never restore a parallel financial truth.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused U006 readback/isolation change set only after a reproduced failure.

tasks.objective: Prove Captain COD and payout mutation idempotency reconciliation and recovery
tasks.currentProblem: Captain COD collect/remit and payout request/destination self-service routes exist, but package closure still requires proof of idempotency/legal states, WLT reconciliation, retry/unknown-result recovery, audit and operator readback.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace each Captain-permitted COD/payout mutation through DSH proxy, WLT owner/persistence/ledger/audit and canonical readback; fix only proven duplicate, stale-state, cross-actor, reconciliation or recovery defects.
tasks.targetState: Retries cannot double-collect/remit/pay; every success is confirmed by WLT-backed readback/audit; operator controls stay permission protected and DSH/frontend never become financial truth.
tasks.action: Run targeted WLT COD/payout/settlement tests and DSH representative-finance route tests; add negative actor/idempotency cases where missing; exercise failure/unknown-result paths; reconcile ledger/audit before marking DONE.
mustNotChange: Do not calculate COD/commission/payout financial truth in DSH or frontend.
Do not bypass service/operator permissions or maker-checker controls.
Do not report success from an unknown client-side result without canonical WLT readback.
acceptanceCriteria: COD/payout retries are duplicate-safe and actor scoped.
Ledger/audit/reconciliation agrees with canonical WLT state after legal transitions.
Unknown/offline failures recover by canonical readback and never fabricate completion.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused mutation fix while preserving audit/ledger history and forward-compatible data; never delete financial evidence to make tests green.
tasks.commitBoundary: Keep COD/payout mutation fixes separate from read-only presentation cleanup and rerun all finance checks on the final U006 candidate.
